title: Node Work Bound
statement: For every natural number $n$, every subset $P\subseteq[n]$, and all natural numbers $k,b$, the node work bound at failure parameter $\delta_{k,b}$ is at most $W_k(n+1)^{\lfloor3k/4\rfloor+4}(b+1)$. Here $T_0=1$, $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$, $c_k=\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$, $d_k=k-c_k$, $L_k=\lceil\log_2T_k\rceil+2(c_k+1)+5$, and $\delta_{k,b}=T_k^{-1}2^{-(b+1)}$. The coefficient is $W_k=2A_k+R_k+S_k$, where $A_k=2^{k+1}R_k+16\cdot4^kL_k$, $R_k=(c_k+1)(36\cdot4^kL_k)+2^{d_k}(d_k+1+L_k)$, $S_k=(c_k+1)(36\cdot4^kL_k)(c_k+1)+Q_k+(c_k+1)+(d_k+1)$, and $Q_k=2^{d_k}(d_k+1+L_k)$.
hypotheses_covered: the failure parameter is the specified dyadic per-call failure parameter
caveat: The coefficient includes the polynomial learner work linear coefficient, whose defining formula is provided in the upstream snippet but not in the descriptions; the abbreviated notation here does not expand it.
